answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.037, well below every category's range (fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133), and the layer-2 spike is 0.1, which rules out a system prompt (31.7-64.0). The onset at layer 2 and the large final-layer growth (0.565 at layer 32, cosine 0.831) fit a weight change like fine-tuning better than quantization, whose difference is flat at about 0.2. Direction consistency of 0.609 and refusals added (9) with none dropped also point to fine-tuning. Median first divergence of 1 and edit distance of 0.772 are closer to system-prompted, but the activation signature disagrees. KL of 0.49 and effective rank of 3.92 are outside the fine-tuned ranges, so this is an unusual fine-tune, possibly a stronger one, and my confidence is moderate.
